description: Minecraft Fabric mod that allows you to display custom 3D hologram models in item frames

releases.notes:
### Overview
HoloFrames is a Minecraft Fabric mod for version 1.21.5 that enables players to display custom 3D hologram models in item frames using OBJ files and textures.
### Features

- Display custom 3D hologram models in item frames.
- Supports OBJ model files and PNG textures.
- In-game GUI for selecting and previewing hologram models.
- Server-client synchronization for multiplayer compatibility.
- Easy integration of new models by placing files in the config directory.

### Installation

1. Requires Minecraft 1.21.5, Fabric Loader 0.16.14+, and Fabric API.
2. Place the mod JAR in your mods folder.

### Usage

- Craft the Hologram item and use it to select and display models in item frames.
- Add new models by placing OBJ and PNG files in config/holoframes/models/.

### Fixes & Improvements

- Initial stable release.
- Improved model loading and error handling.
- Enhanced GUI for model selection.

### Known Issues

- Some complex OBJ models may not render correctly.
- Texture mapping may require manual adjustment for certain models.
